commit_message: OMS SA status/position distribution over ODMRP (OpenSpec + beads)

nodes.title: OMS SA distribution — status 1/20 Hz + position 1/5 Hz over ODMRP
nodes.description:
Distribute OMS system status (every 20 s) and platform position (every 5 s) to all OMS peers on an ODMRP mesh without loops or broadcast storms.

Spec: specs/oms-sa-distribution/spec.md. Builds on specs/odmrp and specs/overlay. Primary risk: today's originate() always piggybacks Join Query (network flood); must add pure-DATA originate after mesh_established.

Parent roadmap: related to overlay/SA feed work; does not replace JREAP product path — periodic peer SA is FG multicast DATA.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- All Gherkin scenarios in specs/oms-sa-distribution/spec.md have pytest-bdd (or unit) coverage and pass.
- After mesh_established, oms_status/oms_position originates are pure DATA (no JQ header).
- Multi-source N-node scenario delivers peer reports without re-originate loops.
- Metrics for offer load, amplification, dup/not_fg drops, delivery ratio, freshness are available from trace or API.
- design.md ADR-008 locked.

nodes.title: ADR-008 — Dual-rate planes and OMS SA rate interpretation
nodes.description: Lock: (1) 1/20 Hz status = period 20 s; 1/5 Hz position = period 5 s; reject production periods < 1 s. (2) Mesh JQ refresh remains ROUTE_REFRESH_INTERVAL; app reports are pure DATA after mesh_established. (3) Default group oms.sa; optional split groups via config. (4) fg_scope stays group. (5) Compact AppPayload kinds oms_status / oms_position — not full UCI XML on mesh.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- ADR-008 written in design.md.
- Spec overview rates table matches ADR.
- Bead closed with decision recorded.

nodes.title: AppPayload oms_status / oms_position encode-decode + platform_id guard
nodes.description: Extend AppPayload with kinds oms_status and oms_position. Fields per specs/oms-sa-distribution/spec.md. Originate path MUST reject payloads whose platform_id does not match the local node mapping. Prefer compact JSON or structured dict encoding suitable for mesh MTU; document size budget.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- Round-trip encode/decode unit tests.
- Foreign platform_id originate rejected.
- Inbox / SA store exposes kind and platform_id.

nodes.title: Pure DATA originate after mesh_established (no JQ flood per report)
nodes.description: P0 storm fix. Add originate_data (or originate flag) on ODMRPNode / PythonODMRPNode / engine / messaging: when session.mesh_established, emit DATA without JoinQueryHeader; still use shared seq space and message cache. First originate or refresh path retains ADR-002 JQ piggyback. Update external-node contract + FakeNode. Do not change FG/dup-cache receive rules.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- Spec scenarios 'Subsequent position reports are pure DATA' and 'Mesh refresh still emits Join Query on interval' pass.
- Trace shows JQ count decoupled from position originate count.
- Java parity tracked as follow-up note if deferred.

nodes.title: OMS SA publisher service — status/position timers with phase offset
nodes.description: New service (e.g. services/oms_sa.py) driven by sim clock: status_period_s=20, position_period_s=5, per-node phase offsets. Starts only when node is active OMS peer + group member. Uses pure-DATA originate when mesh established. Config validation rejects unsafe periods in production mode.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- Spec timer scenarios pass.
- Phase offsets desynchronize N nodes in unit test.
- Production config validation scenario passes.

nodes.title: OMS SA consumer store — freshness, stale at 2× period, newer wins
nodes.description: Per-node store keyed by platform_id for latest status and position. Apply generated_at ordering (newer wins; late older ignored). Mark stale when age > 2× configured period. Optional hook to emit edge uci.platform.status-shaped events for local ASB adapters (document only or thin callback).
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- Spec stale and newer-generated_at scenarios pass.
- API or get_state exposes peer SA snapshot with stale flags.

nodes.title: Scenario + Gherkin: multi-source oms.sa on overlay-mesh
nodes.description: Add scenarios/oms-sa-mesh.yaml (or extend overlay-mesh) with N members all sources. pytest-bdd steps for specs/oms-sa-distribution scenarios: multi-source delivery, no foreign re-originate, pure DATA vs JQ counts, tunnel unicast-over-neighbors.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- BDD scenarios for multi-source status/position pass.
- Assert Join Query flood count == refresh count not position count for a settled window.
- Fixture checked into scenarios/ and optionally fixtures/overlay/.

nodes.title: SA metrics: offer load, amplification, drops, delivery, freshness, overhead
nodes.description: Summarize from trace/event bus: offer msgs/s, TX amplification (flood vs FG), dup drop rate, not_fg drop rate, delivery ratio, freshness age p95, control overhead (JQ+JR bytes/DATA bytes), message_cache occupancy. Expose via GET /api/oms-sa/metrics or extend gateway/sa status. Align with roadmap observability bead odmrp-5z4 but keep SA-specific summary usable in prototype without OTel.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- Spec 'Trace supports amplification accounting' passes.
- Documented metric definitions in spec or docs/architecture note.

nodes.title: Docs: sequence + overlay sketch for OMS SA dual-rate path
nodes.description: Add docs/sequences/07-oms-sa-distribution.md (mesh form → pure DATA status/position → refresh JQ). Update docs/overlay-ipsec-sketch.md with SA peer multicast vs JREAP product path distinction. Point README OpenSpec structure at specs/oms-sa-distribution.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- Sequence doc merged.
- Overlay sketch mentions oms_status/oms_position rates and pure DATA rule.
- README lists the new spec.
